title: Windows System Administrator
description:
**Job Title: Window System Administrator**

As a Windows System Administrator, you will be responsible for the maintenance, configuration, and reliable operation of computer systems, network servers, and virtualization. You will work closely with the IT team to ensure the smooth operation of all systems and networks, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and end-user problems.

**Responsibilities:**

**System Maintenance and Configuration:**  
 Install, configure, and maintain Windows operating systems and applications.  
 Monitor system performance and ensure reliability and availability.  
 Perform regular system updates and upgrades.

**Server Administration:**   
 Manage Windows servers, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and file servers.  
 Configure and maintain virtualization on platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.  
 Implement and manage backup and recovery solutions.

**Network Management:**   
 Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity issues.  
 Configure and maintain network switches, routers, and firewalls.  
 Implement and maintain VPN solutions for remote access.

**Security Compliance:**   
 Implement security measures to protect systems and data from unauthorized access.  
 Monitor systems for security breaches and respond to incidents promptly.  
 Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

**User Support:**   
 To provide technical support to end-users, resolving hardware and software issues.  
 Assist in the setup and configuration of new user accounts and devices.  
 To Train users on basic system usage and best practices.

**Documentation and Reporting:**   
 Maintain accurate documentation of system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.  
 Generate reports on system performance, security incidents, and user support activities.

**Requirements:**   
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).  
 Proven experience as a Windows System Administrator or similar role.  
 Strong knowledge of Windows Server operating systems (2008/2012/2016/2019).  
 Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and other Windows server roles.  
 Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V.  
 Knowledge of network protocols and services (TCP/IP, VPN, VLANs, etc.).  
 Experience with security tools and practices, such as firewalls, antivirus software, and intrusion detection/prevention on systems.  
 Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.  
 Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent over a decade designing analog circuits that have to move data at speeds most engineers never touch, and you know that the difference between a SERDES that works in simulation and one that works in silicon is a hundred small decisions about layout, process variation, and timing handoff. You are the kind of engineer who reads a SerDes standard and immediately starts sketching architectures that push beyond what the spec requires because you see where the bottleneck will be two years from now.

You do not wait for someone to tell you the PLL is the problem. You run the jitter budget, trace it back to the oscillator, and propose three solutions before the next design review. Taped-out circuits in FinFET nodes where a few femtofarads of parasitic capacitance can kill your bandwidth have taught you to work with layout engineers who understand that your redline is not optional.

Presenting simulation data to a customer review panel and explaining why your adaptive equalizer architecture will handle their worst-case channel without adding another milliwatt is something you do comfortably. Mentoring matters to you, not because it looks good on a review, but because you remember the senior engineer who taught you how to read an eye diagram and you want to be that person for someone else.

At Synopsys, you will work on Multi-Gbps SERDES IP that goes into chips that power data centers, automotive networks, and AI accelerators. The problems are hard, the process nodes are cutting-edge, and what you design will ship.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Review high-speed SerDes standards (PCIe, Ethernet, USB, CXL) and translate them into transceiver architectures and detailed sub-block specifications for Multi-Gbps NRZ and PAM4 designs
* Architect and design analog/mixed-signal circuits including TX drivers, RX front-ends, adaptive equalizers, PLLs, DLLs, bandgap references, regulators, oscillators, and ADC/DAC blocks for advanced FinFET and gate-all-around process nodes
* Collaborate with digital design teams on analog/digital co-design, calibration loops, adaptation algorithms, and timing handoff to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance
* Work directly with layout engineers to guide physical implementation, minimize parasitics, manage device stress and process variation, and ensure robust post-silicon performance
* Present simulation results, design trade-offs, and architectural decisions in internal reviews, customer meetings, and industry panel discussions
* Document design features, simulation methodologies, test plans, and characterization results, and support post-silicon bring-up and debug with electrical analysis and design iteration proposals
* Analyze customer silicon data and field performance to identify improvement opportunities and drive post-silicon design updates for next-generation IP releases

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Define the architectural direction for Synopsys SERDES IP, influencing product roadmaps and enabling next-generation connectivity standards across automotive, data center, and AI markets
* Deliver power, performance, and area improvements that directly affect the competitiveness of Synopsys IP in advanced process nodes and high-speed communication applications
* Solve post-silicon challenges that unblock customer tape-outs and ensure successful deployment of Synopsys IP in high-volume production chips
* Mentor analog designers across the team, raising the technical bar for circuit design, simulation methodology, and design-for-reliability practices
* Strengthen Synopsys leadership in Multi-Gbps SERDES by contributing to industry standards bodies, customer engagements, and technical publications
* Enable faster time-to-market for customers by streamlining design and verification flows and reducing silicon respins through robust pre-silicon validation
* Shape the future of high-speed analog design at Synopsys by driving innovation in adaptive equalization, low-power PLLs, and signal integrity for next-generation process technologies

### **What You'll Need**

* MTech/MS with 8+ years or BTech/BS with 10+ years of hands-on analog IC design experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* Proven track record of CMOS tape-outs in FinFET technologies with demonstrable experience in Multi-Gbps high-speed designs using NRZ and PAM4 modulation
* Deep expertise in SERDES sub-circuit design including TX drivers, RX front-ends, adaptive equalizers, PLLs, DLLs, bandgap references, regulators, oscillators, and data converters
* Strong understanding of analog/digital co-design, calibration and adaptation algorithms, and timing handoff between analog and digital domains
* Proficiency with schematic entry, physical layout collaboration, design verification tools, and SPICE simulators (Spectre, HSPICE, or similar)
* Experience with scripting languages such as TCL, PERL, or MATLAB for post-processing simulation data and automating design tasks
* Solid grounding in system-level budgeting for jitter, amplitude, and noise, and familiarity with signal integrity challenges including packaging parasitics, crosstalk, and channel loss. Experience with ESD protection, custom digital design, and design-for-reliability considerations (electromigration, IR drop, aging, self-heating) is a plus. Prior experience with high-speed interleaved SAR ADCs is a strong plus.

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a design review, look at a jitter waterfall plot, and pinpoint the architectural bottleneck in under five minutes without needing a slide deck
* You push back when a specification does not make sense or when a layout decision will compromise performance, and you do it with data and a proposed alternative
* You are the engineer others come to when a circuit is not behaving and simulation does not match silicon, because you know how to debug across domains and find the real root cause
* You write clear, thorough documentation because you know that six months from now, someone else will need to understand your design choices and you want them to succeed
* You stay current with emerging process technologies, circuit techniques, and industry standards because you know that what works in 7nm will not necessarily work in 3nm
* You value collaboration and knowledge-sharing, and you take the time to explain a complex trade-off to a junior engineer or a non-technical stakeholder without losing the nuance

title: IT System Administrator
description:
**About Us :-**

We are a healthcare technology company supporting virtual care programmes across the United States. Reliable IT  
  
operations, secure access, and careful handling of company and healthcare information are essential to our day-to-day  
  
work.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for 5-8 years experienced, hands-on IT Systems Administrator to support employees and day-to-day IT  
  
operations from India, primarily during U.S.-aligned working hours. The role combines Microsoft 365 administration, user  
  
support, onboarding and offboarding, with a critical focus on Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and Azure virtual  
  
machine operations. The successful candidate should be able to provision VMs, troubleshoot AVD and remote access  
  
issues, and resolve user access and connectivity problems. AWS knowledge is useful at a foundational or support level;  
  
strong practical Azure and AVD skills are the priority.

Critical Skill Area: Microsoft Azure & Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)

  

Hands-on Azure and AVD experience is the most important technical requirement. The candidate should be able to carry  
  
out routine administration and first-/second-level troubleshooting, follow change and security procedures, document  
  
actions, and escalate complex infrastructure issues with useful diagnostic details.

* Provision new Azure virtual machines using approved images and sizing; select the correct subscription, resource

  
group, region, VM size, disk configuration, and network settings according to documented requirements.  
  

* Start, stop, restart, and check the health/status of Azure VMs; identify common causes of a VM being unavailable.

  

* Support AVD user access: validate user/group assignment, application group or desktop assignment, host pool

  
association, and relevant access prerequisites.

* Troubleshoot AVD sign-in and connection problems, including users unable to see desktops/apps, failed connections,

  
session launch errors, profile-loading issues, and sessions that are disconnected or unresponsive.  
  

* Perform initial checks on session hosts: availability, registration/health status, capacity, resource utilisation, and

  
whether the host is accepting connections; escalate host-pool or service-level issues when needed.  
  

* Investigate remote access issues involving user permissions, Entra ID sign-in, MFA, network reachability, DNS, VPN

  
where applicable, and RDP/AVD client configuration.  
  

* Review Azure VM and AVD diagnostic information, activity logs, monitoring signals, and relevant error messages to

  
gather evidence before escalating.  
  

* Support AVD/RDP onboarding and offboarding, including granting and removing approved access and validating that

  
changes have taken effect.

* Assist with Windows VM maintenance such as routine updates, reboot coordination, disk-space checks, basic

  
performance troubleshooting, and post-maintenance validation, following change approvals.  
  

* Understand resource groups, virtual networks/subnets, network security groups (NSGs), managed disks,

  
snapshots/images, Azure Monitor, and Azure Backup; make changes only within approved permissions and  
  
procedures.  
  

* Follow secure-access practices: never expose RDP broadly to the internet, do not bypass access controls, and

  
escalate suspected security incidents or unauthorised access immediately.  
  

* Maintain clear ticket notes covering the issue, checks performed, findings, actions taken, outcome, and any escalation

  
or follow-up required.

**Microsoft 365 & User Administration**

* Handle routine Microsoft 365 administration for user accounts, licences, Outlook/Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive,

  
and SharePoint access.  
  

* Troubleshoot common sign-in, password/MFA, mailbox, Teams, and permissions issues; recognise when an issue

  
requires escalation.  
  

* Create/configure user accounts and access during onboarding; disable accounts, remove licences, and revoke access

  
during offboarding, following approved checklists.  
  

* Manage basic group membership, distribution list membership, shared mailbox access, and other approved access

  
requests.  
  

* Verify approvals before granting access or changing user accounts, licences, groups, or shared resources.

**User Support, Tickets & IT Operations**

* Own and progress assigned support tickets for U.S.-based users, prioritising by business impact and urgency.

  

* Acknowledge requests, communicate progress clearly, set realistic expectations, and update tickets before closure.

  

* Resolve common Windows, laptop, peripheral, connectivity, application, and account-access issues; escalate issues

  
outside the role's permissions or expertise.  
  

* Maintain accurate laptop and accessory inventory and asset assignment/acknowledgement records.

  

* Follow documented onboarding/offboarding checklists and record completion.

  

* Document repeat incidents and troubleshooting steps so the team can resolve similar issues consistently.

**AWS — Foundational / Secondary Support**

AWS is a secondary skill area rather than the primary ownership requirement. The candidate should have basic familiarity  
  
with the AWS console and be able to assist with straightforward support checks under guidance.  
  

* Understand the purpose of IAM users/roles and permissions, EC2 instances, security groups, and S3 buckets.

  

* Perform basic status and access checks, gather troubleshooting information, and escalate AWS issues that require

  
deeper administration.  
  

* Follow least-privilege and approval requirements; do not make unapproved changes to production resources or

  
permissions.

**Security, Documentation & Escalation**

* Follow access approval processes, least-privilege principles, MFA requirements, and company security procedures.

  

* Handle company and healthcare-related information carefully; do not include sensitive information in unauthorised

  
tools or ticket notes.  
  

* Escalate critical incidents, suspected security issues, repeated failures, or changes with production impact promptly.

  

* Maintain useful documentation for VM provisioning, AVD access, common connection issues, onboarding/offboarding,

  
and recurring incidents.

**Working Hours & Support Coverage**

This is an India-based role. The employee will primarily work U.S.-aligned hours to support the company's users and IT  
  
operations. Flexibility is required to provide support during India business hours when a critical incident or urgent business requirement makes it necessary. India-hours support is for critical needs and is not the routine working schedule.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Practical hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD); this is the critical technical

  
requirement.  
  

* Ability to provision Azure VMs and troubleshoot common VM availability, AVD sign-in, desktop/application access,

  
session, and connectivity issues.  
  

* Working understanding of Azure subscriptions, resource groups, VM sizing/disks, virtual networks, NSGs, and basic

  
Azure monitoring/logs.  
  

* Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365 user administration and common Outlook, Teams, account, licence, and

  
access issues.  
  

* Experience handling user support tickets and following structured onboarding/offboarding processes.

  

* Clear written and spoken communication, reliable ticket updates, good documentation, and willingness to escalate

  
appropriately.  
  

* Based in India and available to work primarily U.S.-aligned hours, with flexibility to support critical incidents during

  
India business hours.

**Nice to Have**

* Basic AWS exposure, especially IAM, EC2, security groups, and S3.

  

* Experience with Windows Server, RDP, Entra ID, MFA, VPN, DNS, and networking fundamentals.

  

* Familiarity with PowerShell or basic scripting for troubleshooting and repetitive tasks.

  

* Experience with Freshdesk or another ticketing/ITSM platform.

  

* Exposure to endpoint security, BitLocker, device inventory, or healthcare/regulatory environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Routine Azure VM and AVD requests are handled accurately, securely, and with appropriate documentation.

  

* AVD access and connection issues are investigated systematically, resolved where within scope, and escalated with

  
useful evidence when needed.  
  

* user tickets handled during U.S.-aligned working hours receive timely updates and are progressed according to urgency and agreed service expectations.

  

* Onboarding and offboarding tasks are completed using approved checklists, with access changes recorded.

  

* Critical incidents are escalated promptly, and the employee can provide critical India-hours support when required.

**Suggested Experience Level**
  
  
Experience level: Open to candidates with relevant hands-on IT administration and systems support experience.  
  
Demonstrable practical Azure and AVD capability is essential; the role title and seniority can be aligned to the candidate's depth of experience.

description:

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19281****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/14/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

### **You Are**

You have spent years in the trenches of mixed-signal verification, and you know that the hardest problems live at the boundary where digital meets analog. You are the engineer who can read a waveform, spot the timing violation that three others missed, and trace it back to a testbench assumption made two months ago. You do not just run regressions, you architect verification strategies that catch the subtle, the corner case, the thing that only shows up at 56 Gbps under specific PVT conditions.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead verification of high-speed SerDes IP using UVM and SystemVerilog testbenches in mixed-signal co-simulation environments
* Define, track, and execute verification test plans for PCIE, Ethernet, USB3.1, and other high-speed protocols from architecture through tapeout
* Debug simulation failures across digital and analog domains, working directly with waveform viewers, mixed-signal simulators, and protocol analyzers
* Build and extend UVM testbenches with constrained random sequences, coverage models, and checkers that target real-world corner cases
* Collaborate daily with digital, analog, and mixed-signal design teams to align verification strategy with design intent and silicon bring-up realities
* Manage customer escalations by reproducing issues, root-causing failures, and driving resolution with engineering and field teams
* Drive pre-sales and post-sales technical discussions with customers, translating verification results into confidence and clarity
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure that SerDes IP shipping to customers meets performance, functionality, and reliability targets before it ever reaches silicon
* Reduce post-silicon debug cycles by catching mixed-signal integration issues early through rigorous co-simulation and coverage-driven verification
* Set the technical direction for verification methodology across current and next-generation SerDes products
* Accelerate customer adoption and satisfaction by resolving escalations quickly and providing clear, actionable technical guidance
* Mentor and elevate the verification team by establishing best practices, code reviews, and a culture of ownership and quality
* Contribute directly to Synopsys IP competitiveness by delivering verification environments that scale across protocol variants and process nodes
* Influence product roadmaps by surfacing verification insights that shape architecture and design decisions upstream
  

  

### **What You'll Need**

* MTech or BTech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent with 7+ years of hands-on verification experience in ASIC or mixed-signal environments
* Deep expertise in UVM, SystemVerilog, and verification methodologies including constrained random testing, functional coverage, and assertions
* Proven experience with digital/analog co-simulation tools and methodologies, including AMS simulators and mixed-signal verification flows
* Working knowledge of high-speed interface protocols such as PCIE, Ethernet, or USB3.1, including protocol-level verification and compliance
* Strong understanding of the full ASIC development flow from architecture specification through RTL design, verification, and hardware bring-up
* Experience writing complex system-level testbenches in UVM, including sequence libraries, scoreboards, and protocol monitors
* Hands-on experience debugging waveform-level failures in both digital logic and analog circuit behavior
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room with analog designers discussing CDR loop dynamics and digital engineers debating clock domain crossings, and contribute meaningfully to both conversations
* You have managed customer escalations before and know how to balance urgency with thoroughness, reproducing the issue, isolating root cause, and communicating status without overselling or underselling
* You lead by setting the example, whether that is writing cleaner testbench code, asking the hard question in a design review, or staying late to close a critical bug before tapeout
* You make decisions with incomplete information, prioritize what matters, and course-correct when new data arrives without losing momentum
* You can explain a complex verification failure to a field applications engineer in two sentences and to a design lead in a ten-minute whiteboard session, adjusting depth and framing to the audience
* You build relationships across functions because you know that the best verification strategies come from understanding what design, applications, and customers actually need
  

  

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will be part of a highly skilled team of digital, analog, and mixed-signal engineers responsible for delivering high-end mixed-signal designs from specification to implementation. This team thrives on collaboration, excellence, and pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver top-notch SerDes products to customers worldwide.

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:
**Date posted** 10/11/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19196****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/11/2026**

**Vulnerability Management Analyst - Semiconductor IP**

**We Are:**

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

**You Are:**

You are someone who builds trust with product and engineering teams when the topic is risk. You listen first, explain complex findings in clear language, and own your conclusions. You help people understand what a vulnerability means for their work and what they should do next.

You are practical when information is incomplete. You stay focused on timely action, challenge unclear choices in a respectful way, and keep looking for better ways to reduce risk. You care about teamwork, follow-through, and leaving guidance that others can use.

This is a full-time role.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Analyze vulnerabilities affecting semiconductor IP products, firmware, and related interfaces, and determine residual risk with clear assumptions.
* Prioritize findings so product teams can act in a timely way: severity, exploitability, affected assets, and recommended mitigations.
* Work with design, verification, firmware, and product teams to explain vulnerabilities, walk through impact, and agree how the team will mitigate.
* Advise those teams on practical mitigations, compensating controls, and verification or test evidence that shows the risk is reduced.
* Work in semiconductor IP development and associated test flows, using the tools those teams use to design, verify, and test IP, so analysis matches how the product is actually built.
* Build and maintain your own analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting tools, including in Python, when existing tools are not enough. Scripts and tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Track open risk through the cybersecurity lifecycle, from intake through analysis, treatment, verification, and internal release decisions, and keep status current.
* Facilitate working sessions so similar IP classes get consistent analysis, risk language, and mitigation guidance.
* Look for new and practical ways to detect, assess, and mitigate risk, including improved methods, automation, and lessons from prior findings.
* Use agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) to speed research and first drafts without handing off ownership of risk conclusions.
* Run the job in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track vulnerability and risk work, keep documentation current, and version work products through review.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Give product teams vulnerability analysis and risk determinations they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
* Reduce time-to-mitigation by explaining findings clearly and agreeing practical next steps with the teams that own the product.
* Leave mitigation and test guidance that design, verification, and firmware teams can execute.
* Keep residual risk visible and current so internal release and treatment decisions are based on evidence, not stale status.
* Improve consistency of vulnerability handling and risk language across similar IP classes.
* Raise the quality of risk reduction over time by bringing new methods, better mitigations, and fit-for-purpose tools into the workflow.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
* Typically 3 or more years in vulnerability management, product cybersecurity, embedded security, or a closely related engineering role. Stronger evidence on vulnerability analysis and risk determination can offset fewer years. Title (Analyst or Senior Analyst) will match demonstrated depth.
* Strong practical experience in vulnerability analysis on real products, not only scanning or training exercises.
* Ability to determine risk: severity, exploitability, affected assets, likelihood, impact, and residual risk after proposed mitigations.
* Ability to explain vulnerabilities and recommended mitigations to engineering teams so they can act in a timelyway.
* Working familiarity with semiconductor IP development and associated testing, including the tools used to design, verify, and test IP. Specific commercial tool names are not required.
* Ability to write and maintain your own tools, including in Python, for analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting when existing tools are not enough. This is not a software-engineering role. Tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Experience working with incomplete information and stating assumptions when the end-system is not fully known.
Experience* ing a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, design, implementation, verification, and internal release, including tracking open risk to closure.
* Hands-on understanding of embedded systems enough to reason about hardware-rooted and firmware vulnerabilities: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, interfaces, registers, boot and debug, and interconnects.
* Experience delivering analysis inside product-team cadence, including re-prioritizing when new findings or design changes arrive.
* Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.

* Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions with geographically distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of common vulnerability scoring and handling practice (for example CVSS) is helpful, as is ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard, digital design or verification background (including RTL), semiconductor IP product experience, or applied embedded cryptography.

**Who You Are:**

* You build trust with design and product teams and keep working relationships strong when the discussion is about risk.
* You own the technical conclusion. You do not hand off judgment to a scanner, a score, a tool, or the loudest voice in the room.
* You write and speak clearly so engineers can understand a vulnerability and how to mitigate it without you in the room.
* You work well with incomplete information, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
* You drive timely action. You keep risk visible until it is treated or accepted with a clear rationale.
* You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend mitigations teams can actually adopt.
* You keep learning. You look for new and practical ways to assess and reduce risk, not only the methods you already know.
* You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
* You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as findings and designs change.

**The Team You’ll Be** **A** **Part Of:**

You will join the CySec Vulnerability Management Team that supports Synopsys semiconductor IP products. You work with IP product teams in their delivery cadence. You collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, firmware, and verification engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to analyze vulnerabilities, determine risk, and agree mitigations through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Your written work products are used by internal product and engineering teams.

**Rewards and Benefits:**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: ServiceNow ITSM Techno-Functional Consultant
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**


To support the Service Automation team within Siemens Energy's Digital Core, this role is established to backfill capacity and address the increased workload from expanded responsibilities and upcoming strategic Energy Now initiatives. Operating at the Experienced Professional (P2\) level in India, the consultant will ensure operational stability, service excellence, and successful execution across key service areas. To address these business aims, the role focuses on ServiceNow ITSM solution design, platform configuration, and stakeholder collaboration. These core areas ensure alignment between business processes and technical implementations while driving out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) adoption and minimizing platform customizations.


**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **ServiceNow Solution Design \& Implementation**
* + Design and deliver scalable, upgrade\-safe solutions across ServiceNow ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management) leveraging out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) capabilities.
	+ Configure core platform architecture, including Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, custom scripting, and third\-party tool integrations (e.g., Snowflake, Jira, Salesforce).
	+ Implement and manage technical integrations using REST, SOAP, MID Server, and Import Sets, ensuring alignment with platform security models and ACLs.
	+ Promote OOTB adoption, minimize unnecessary customizations, and leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities to deliver efficient solutions.
* **Functional Consulting \& Stakeholder Management**
* + Conduct discovery workshops and sessions with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate requirements into functional specifications.
	+ Prepare comprehensive design documents and define acceptance criteria to guide technical teams and review final solution designs.
	+ Provide strategic recommendations on ServiceNow best practices, process optimization, and alignment with CMDB, CSDM, and SPM modules.
* **Project Delivery \& Operational Support**
* + Collaborate within Agile/Scrum and SAFe delivery environments to support the execution of strategic EnergyNow projects and initiatives.
	+ Perform acceptance testing, validate solutions against requirements, and coordinate deployment activities with delivery partners to ensure operational stability.

**What You Bring**

* 6 to 8 years of professional experience in ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management (CIS\-ITSM).
* ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting experience.
* ServiceNow Core Architecture \& Administration.
* Flow Designer \& IntegrationHub Configuration.
* ServiceNow Scripting \& Customization Best Practices.
* Integration Technologies (REST, SOAP, MID Server, Import Sets).
* IT Service Management (ITSM) Process Design.
* Common Service Data Model (CSDM) \& CMDB.
* Requirement Gathering \& Business Systems Analysis.
* Solution Architecture \& Design Documentation.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication.
* Agile/Scrum \& SAFe Methodologies.
* Analytical Problem\-Solving.

**About the Team**


Our Corporate and Global Functions play a critical role in driving Siemens Energy’s strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across departments, business areas, and regions. As part of this team, you will contribute to shaping the global energy transition, partner with internal and external stakeholders, and conduct business responsibly while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
